name: 'Callisto Release-PR Action'
description: 'Creates or updates a Callisto release PR; durable execution belongs to the repository workflow'
inputs:
  version_command:
    description: 'Version command; defaults to callisto version, which refreshes lockfiles. Callisto appends --emit-decision <decision_path>.'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto version'
  decision_path:
    description: 'Path, relative to cwd, where the version command records the exact release decision this PR carries. Committed alongside the manifest and changelog edits; `callisto release plan --from-release-commit` verifies the merged commit against this file rather than re-deriving release policy.'
    required: false
    default: '.callisto/release-decision.json'
  commit_message:
    description: 'Release-PR commit message'
    required: false
    default: 'chore(release): version packages'
  title:
    description: 'Release-PR title'
    required: false
    default: 'chore(release): version packages'
  pr_label:
    description: 'Release-PR label'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto: release'
  setup_git_user:
    description: 'Unused no-op, kept for backward compatibility. The managed branch is committed through the forge commit API, not a local `git commit`, so no Git identity is ever configured.'
    required: false
    default: 'true'
  branch:
    description: 'Base branch for the release PR'
    required: false
    default: 'main'
  release_branch:
    description: 'Branch managed for the release PR'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto/version-packages'
  github_token:
    description: 'Optional GitHub token for pull-request and forge commit API operations. The managed branch is never pushed with `git push`; the default GITHUB_TOKEN is sufficient even on a public repository, since the executor never writes `.github/workflows/*`.'
    required: false
    default: ''
  setup_callisto:
    description: 'Install the Callisto environment before running'
    required: false
    default: 'true'
  version:
    description: >-
      Version tag of Callisto to install. Default 'latest' installs the release this action's own
      invocation is pinned to (github.action_ref resolved against callisto@ tags), falling back to
      the newest published release when that ref is unset or unresolvable.
    required: false
    default: 'latest'
  cwd:
    description: 'Workspace directory'
    required: false
    default: '.'
  mode:
    description: 'version-pr (default): create/update the release PR. release: run `callisto release`.'
    required: false
    default: 'version-pr'
outputs:
  hasChangesets:
    description: 'Whether pending changesets were found (mode: version-pr only)'
    value: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}
  published:
    description: 'Whether `callisto release` published anything (mode: release only; otherwise false)'
    value: ${{ steps.release.outputs.published || 'false' }}
  publishedPackages:
    description: 'JSON array of packages `callisto release` published (mode: release only; otherwise [])'
    value: ${{ steps.release.outputs.publishedPackages || '[]' }}
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Validate mode
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/validate-mode.sh"
    # setup-callisto's own steps, called directly rather than through its
    # `uses:` (both `$/` and an external owner/repo/path@ref resolve against
    # whichever ref invoked *this* action, not necessarily a real one -- see
    # setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh's header). github.action_path
    # is this action's own checked-out directory, so a sibling-relative path
    # always uses the same ref this action itself was invoked at.
    - name: Install Rust Toolchain & Cache
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      # orin-dx/actions/setup-rust v1.1
      uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db
      with:
        components: clippy,rustfmt
        shared-key: "callisto-workspace-shared"
        save-if: "true"
      env:
        CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
        CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE: "true"
    - name: Install moon and the .prototools toolchain
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      # moonrepo/setup-toolchain v0
      uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095
      with:
        auto-install: true
    - name: Install or Build Callisto Binary
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE: auto
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION: fallback
        GITHUB_ACTION_REF: ${{ github.action_ref }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}
      run: bash "${{ github.action_path }}/../setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh" # zizmor: ignore[github-env] the PATH entry is a fixed child of the trusted runner temporary directory, not action input or downloaded archive content.
    - name: Create or update release PR
      id: version-pr
      if: inputs.mode == 'version-pr'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_VERSION_COMMAND: ${{ inputs.version_command }}
        INPUT_DECISION_PATH: ${{ inputs.decision_path }}
        INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE: ${{ inputs.commit_message }}
        INPUT_TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}
        INPUT_PR_LABEL: ${{ inputs.pr_label }}
        INPUT_SETUP_GIT_USER: ${{ inputs.setup_git_user }}
        INPUT_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.branch }}
        INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.release_branch }}
        INPUT_CWD: ${{ inputs.cwd }}
        # GitHub exposes the installation token as a context, not a guaranteed
        # inherited environment variable. Using the context also works for the
        # repository workflow that invokes this action after checkout.
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh"
    - name: Run release
      id: release
      if: inputs.mode == 'release'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_CWD: ${{ inputs.cwd }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/run-release.sh"

      # orin-dx/actions/setup-rust v1.1

      with:
        components: clippy,rustfmt

        save-if: "true"
      env:
        CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
        CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE: "true"
    - name: Install moon and the .prototools toolchain
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      # moonrepo/setup-toolchain v0
      uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095

        auto-install: true
    - name: Install or Build Callisto Binary

        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION: fallback
        GITHUB_ACTION_REF: ${{ github.action_ref }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}

        INPUT_DECISION_PATH: ${{ inputs.decision_path }}
        INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE: ${{ inputs.commit_message }}
        INPUT_TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}
        INPUT_PR_LABEL: ${{ inputs.pr_label }}
        INPUT_SETUP_GIT_USER: ${{ inputs.setup_git_user }}
        INPUT_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.branch }}
        INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.release_branch }}

        # inherited environment variable. Using the context also works for the

      if: inputs.mode == 'release'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_CWD: ${{ inputs.cwd }}

      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/run-release.sh"

//! Manifest reading and MatrixReport assembly for `callisto matrix`.
//! Private helpers only -- the public entry point is
//! `crate::commands::matrix::matrix`.

/// Per-triple CI scheduling attributes for the 18 triples
/// `crate::napi::triple_to_role` recognises today. This table is NEW code:
/// `triple_to_role`'s `ManifestRole::Platform` carries only platform/arch/abi
/// and has no concept of hostRunner/useCross, so this cannot be derived from
/// it. Returns `None` for any triple `triple_to_role` does not recognise --
/// callers must treat that as the unrecognised-triple diagnostic path, never a silent
/// default.
pub(crate) fn triple_host_runner_use_cross(triple: &str) -> Option<(&'static str, bool)> {
    Some(match triple {
        "aarch64-apple-darwin" => ("macos-latest", false),
        "x86_64-apple-darwin" => ("macos-13", false),
        "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu" => ("ubuntu-latest", false),
        "x86_64-unknown-linux-musl" => ("ubuntu-latest", true),
        "aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu" => ("ubuntu-latest", true),
        "aarch64-unknown-linux-musl" => ("ubuntu-latest", true),
        "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc" => ("windows-latest", false),
        "i686-pc-windows-msvc" => ("windows-latest", false),
        "aarch64-pc-windows-msvc" => ("windows-latest", false),
        "armv7-unknown-linux-gnueabihf" => ("ubuntu-latest", true),
        "x86_64-unknown-freebsd" => ("ubuntu-latest", true),
        "aarch64-linux-android" => ("ubuntu-latest", true),
        "armv7-linux-androideabi" => ("ubuntu-latest", true),
        "riscv64gc-unknown-linux-gnu" => ("ubuntu-latest", true),
        "powerpc64le-unknown-linux-gnu" => ("ubuntu-latest", true),
        "s390x-unknown-linux-gnu" => ("ubuntu-latest", true),
        "wasm32-wasip1" => ("ubuntu-latest", false),
        "wasm32-unknown-unknown" => ("ubuntu-latest", false),
        _ => return None,
    })
}

/// ArtifactName embeds the package's own (already workspace-unique)
/// name alongside platform/arch/abi, mirroring napi-rs's own
/// published-package and recommended-CI-artifact convention
    if: always() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - id: macos-arm64
            runner: macos-14
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: macos-x64
            runner: macos-14
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
            kind: cross
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read

Non-interactive, for scripts, agents, and most contributors:

```bash
callisto add --package <crate>:<bump> --summary "..."
```

`--package` takes repeatable `name:severity` pairs (`none`, `patch`, `minor`, `major`).

Interactive wizard (omit `--package`/`--summary`, run from a TTY): prompts for packages, then major-bump packages, then minor-bump packages (rest default to patch), then a summary, then a confirmation preview before writing `.changeset/<slug>.md`.

```bash
cargo run --bin callisto -- add
```

## Current boundaries and planned changes

`PackageId` is a flexible selector/display form; `PackageKey` is a directory locator; `ReleasePackageId` is a canonical ecosystem-qualified distribution identity. A directory can own several canonical manifests, but the current package model requires one version grammar. Registry version observations do not establish a complete Python file set or identical package bytes.

Remaining v1 work is in [`docs/projects/ROAD-TO-V1.md`](docs/projects/ROAD-TO-V1.md). The canonical-identity and polyglot model is in [`docs/architecture/polyglot-v1.md`](docs/architecture/polyglot-v1.md); only the parts it marks as design are not implemented, and none is an extension seam. The existing dependency graph and release-operation DAG remain the basis of the plan.

## Not covered here

**proto plugin**
- proto/callisto.toml:7 and :12 list only macOS `aarch64` and Linux `x86_64`.
- The README Install section says proto installs from a release binary, but Intel macOS and arm64 Linux binaries are now published (callisto.toml:27-42, release.md:130). Intel macOS and arm64 Linux users cannot get a binary through proto.
- This file is outside your list. It is a judgment call whether the plugin is stale.

## Worth a human glance (probably true, or I could not fully check)
- **docs/publishing.md:101.** It says a package tagged by an earlier version with only some files uploaded "is reported as released when rerun at the same commit". Current `incomplete_tagged_releases` (crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release/local.rs:105-140) observes every operation of packages tagged on HEAD. Whether the PyPI partial-file case counts as Exact there is unclear; it depends on the PyPI `observe` without a built file set. It may be stale.
- **docs/publishing.md:15.** "protected `execute` job" could be read as a GitHub Environment, which the repo has none of by owner policy. The workflow's execute job has no `environment:`. Consider "the `execute` job".
- **SECURITY.md:18.** It says contents and pull-requests write go "only to the jobs that need them (`version-pr`, `execute`)". Actually `execute` has `contents: write` and `attestations: read`, with no pull-requests write. `build-artifact` has `id-token` and `attestations: write`. Credentials only in `execute` is true (workflow lines ~436-480).
- **SECURITY.md:24.** It cites `cargo deny check advisories`. The justfile `audit` recipe runs `cargo deny check`, which covers all checks after `license-boundary`.
- **ARCHITECTURE.md invariant 4.** It calls `atomic_write` the only write primitive, but `atomic_write_new` also exists (crates/callisto-model/src/atomic.rs:32).
- **docs/architecture/wire-compat.md.**
  - Line 28 says the nothing-to-release stdout report is version 1. I could not run it, because `release` needs an origin push URL and fails with E132. I did see the error envelope at schemaVersion 1.
  - `release --dry-run --format json` prints the intent (schemaVersion 5), which the doc does not mention.
  - The doc does not mention the status, version, snapshot and matrix reports at 2. I confirmed those four are 2 via binary runs and crates/callisto-model/src/report.rs:13.
- **crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs:15.** It maps `x86_64-apple-darwin` to the runner `macos-13`, which GitHub has retired. Not a doc claim, but it feeds generated matrices.
- **crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs.** The exit-code header omits `release-pr` and the hidden `help`.
- **docs/publishing.md:100.** The 14-day PyPI rule cites an external blog post I cannot verify.
- **Not documented anywhere in the audited docs.** None of these is stale text; they are gaps.
  - E318: pre mode is refused on the release-PR route.
  - E319: unrewritable dependency ranges.
  - E169: snapshot versions refused by `release`.
  - npm prerelease dist-tag: `npm_dist_tag` in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release/derive.rs:336 publishes a prerelease under its first identifier, or `next`, never `latest`. The "not proof of the npm dist-tag" lines (releasing.md:122, release.md:80) are still true.

## Checked and consistent
- No `petgraph`, `plan-publish`, `callisto publish`, `callisto tag` or `filter-plan` mentions in the audited docs. Mentions in diagnostic.rs are accurate, and the others are CHANGELOGs.
- The 8 visible commands match the docs; hidden `release plan|execute|build-python|artifact-manifest`, `release-pr`, `matrix`, `schema` and `compose-pr-body` exist as documented.
- Version-wave docs: 15s, 45s, 2m, 3m looks; confirm-timeout 6m (npm, PyPI) and 2m (Cargo); publish-timeout 15m; the back-to-back npm window (policy.rs:55-96, release_execution.rs). The `confirm-timeout` and `publish-timeout` config keys match raw.rs.
- Wire-compat schema versions: decision 2 (reads 1 and 2), intent 5, envelope 3, receipt 2, artifact manifest 1, snapshot 1.
- Release targets list (5), the `v1` floating-tag text, `setup-callisto` defaults, and the Cargo `edition = "2024"` / `rust-version = "1.96"` (no doc mentions an MSRV).
- Config enum values and defaults, and the init reminder text.
- Library crates documented as internal and lockstep (crate READMEs, fixed-group in callisto.toml).
- No GitHub Environment anywhere in docs. Guard tests assert none.
